name: Shiva hippocampus signal (fast, 3x)
origin: Shiva software by Todd Murphy (signal templates licensed from Persinger and Koren)
summary: Murphy's simple Shiva hippocampus session with the 'LTP' signal played three times faster, stepped counter-clockwise around the head. The vendor says 'fast speeds the signal up by three times, a configuration that elicited fewer phenomenal effects, but was effective in enhancing some hippocampal functions'. The waveform is rebuilt from descriptions.
notes: The vendor: 'fast speeds the signal up by three times' (hippocampus_page.htm). No values of the Shiva 'LTP' file are published; the vendor states only its spectral peak, 5.4 Hz (Shakti 5jut4ranconsent.htm). This file plays a rebuilt primed burst at 1-ms points instead of 3 ms: one pulse, then four pulses 57 ms later, three times in 0.25 s (at normal speed 170 ms and 0.74 s, after Tsang 2004 p.5 [1017]), then 1.33 s of silence. That silence is this project's choice: whether the fast version shortens it is not stated, and on Shakti the high-speed signals 'have no silent intervals' (rapid_&_high_speed_signals.htm). Coils sit on the vendor's Shiva ring (Fp1, FT7, TP7, O1, O2, TP8, FT8, Fp2) and fire one at a time, counter-clockwise seen from above. Shiva has a coil pair at each position; one coil keeps the timing and covers about half the arc. The step of 10, 12 ... 20 ms per coil is this project's reading of a lecture example with no unit named (Murphy lecture 19:42-19:53). This session's step table is not published; lab runs of the amygdala signal used 20 to 6 ms and 100 to 30 ms (Saroka 2010 p.5 [470]) and 100 ms plus 20 ms per position (Collins 2014 p.40 [31]). The vendor gives no number for Shiva's field. This program's setting is the peak field 20 mm in front of each coil. At 1 uT that is about 24 uT at the scalp. The effect is a vendor claim. Independent sham-controlled tests of God-Helmet-type fields found no field effect (Granqvist 2005, double-blind; Gendle & McGrath 2012, where the experimenter knew the condition). Phase 1 alone is the 20-min version; with phase 2 it is the 30-min one. Murphy's cautions: with word-finding problems or feeling 'spaced out', switch to another signal; with headaches or pressure (about 2%), lower the intensity by one third. Not for people with epilepsy; stop if distressed.
setting: Dark, quiet room, eyes closed, relaxed without meditating or falling asleep. Shiva offers 20, 30 and 60-min versions; start with the short one.
schedule: At most once a week, never on consecutive days; up to 6 sessions, then a 21-day break. 60-min sessions weekly or every two weeks at most.
source: Murphy, Shiva demo: Hippocampus signal https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/hippocampus_page.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: What are 'Rapid' and 'High-Speed' signals? https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/rapid_&_high_speed_signals.htm ; Murphy, Shakti demo: Random theta band output (LTP spectral peak) https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/winshakti/demo/shakti_demo/5jut4ranconsent.htm ; Murphy, Shiva demo: Consumer information https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/shiva_infomed_consent.htm ; Murphy, Shiva / Octopus and the 40 Hz binding factor https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/shiva_explanation.htm ; Murphy, Psychic Skills & Miracles lecture https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=tmC1174POpA ; Murphy, Shiva demo: Session lengths https://www.god-helmet.com/wp/shiva/shiva_demo/session_length.htm ; Granqvist et al. 2005, Neurosci Lett 379:1 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/15849873/ ; Gendle & McGrath 2012, Percept Mot Skills 114:217 https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/22582690/
